1999.o: Mumbai Proclamation Ceremony of 'Bhagwan Swaminarayan Flyover'
w: At 10.30 am Swamishri reached the suburb of Sion in Bombay. The Mayor of Bombay, Shri Hareshwar Patil and Deputy Mayor, Shri Rambhai Barot, were also present for this important event. Swamishri was welcomed and honored by the officials. The proclamation ceremony was performed in the presence of Lord Harikrishna Maharaj and amidst Vedic chantings by the sadhus. At 11.00 am the plaque was unveiled by Swamishri, Mayor Shri Hareshwar Patil, Deputy Mayor Shri Rambhai Barot and Shri Kiritbhai Somaiya. The ceremony was received amidst a thunder of claps and victory calls. In the assembly that followed, the Mayor Shri Hareshwar Patil declared the Flyover as 'Bhagwan Swaminarayan Flyover'. In his blessings Swamishri appreciated the efforts of the officials and wished, " That whosoever travels on this Flyover will be blessed by God. They will be blessed with dharma in their lives and become happy in life"

If God or His holy sadhu becomes a priority in life then we can solve and find solutions to many of our problems.
One should go to such places where one's character is preserved and one gets spiritually inspired.

At 9.45 am Swamishri performed the ground breaking ceremony of the BAPS "Pramukh Swami Computer Institute" on a piece of land on the road to Bakrol. At 5.00 pm Swamishri departed from Vidynagar and reached Amdavad at 8.40 pm via Vartal.

After visiting Akshardham on 27 May, the Vice president of India Shri Bhaironsinh Shekhavat arrived at 12.20 p.m. Pujya Kothari Swami and Pujya Viveksagar Swami welcomed him with garlands and then led him for darshan to Akshar Deri. Thereafter the Vice president met Swamishri who welcomed him with a garland. Swamishri then, after performing pujan of Shri Harikrishna Maharaj, applied a chandlo on Shri Shekhavat and tied an auspicious thread on his wrist. Swamishri also welcomed Shri Ashokbhai Bhatt, Shri Vallbhbhai Kathiriya and others. The Vice President shared his impressions about his recent visit to Dwarika, Somnath and the Swaminarayan Mandir in Neasden, London. Shri Shekhavat praised Swamishri's accomplishment in initiating 700 educated sadhus for the service of society. Swamishri explained the glory of Yogiji Maharaj and the divinity of Akshar Deri. The Vice President departed at 1.00 p.m. When the All India Radio reporter asked him about his impression after his meeting with Swamishri he said, "I feel that my pilgrimage has been completed by having the darshan of Swamishri. I experienced a lot of peace. And I would like to say to everyone that two days earlier Pramukh Swamiji initiated 700 sadhus here. And there cannot be a greater gift to society then that."

To please Bhagwan Swaminarayan and Guru Pramukh Swami Maharaj children, youths and senior devotees perform austerities, pilgrimages or other devotional means. The spiritual endeavors performed by the devotees during Swamishri's visit to the local centers are congratulatory and worthy of recognition. It also reflects Swamishri's divinity for inspiring such spiritual efforts in children, teenagers and devotees.

This very morning, while going for the darshan of Thakorji, Pramukh Swami Maharaj saw Brahmatirth Swami standing in front and said, "Brahmatirth! We have to hold a meeting. What happened about that?"
"Bapa! Today is Sunday. There will be a great rush of visitors to see you! So we are thinking of holding the meeting after two or three days."
Swamishri said, "If you keep saying two or three days like this, the days will slip away and you will not even notice! So start finishing it. At 11.00 am, after I have bathed, gather everyone."

Swamishri has always given priority according to the importance of the work. And so today, Sunday, in the midst of the rush of visitors, Swamishri held meetings and completed the planned work. How Swamishri keeps up with the widening scope of his service activities as his age increases, how he does justice to even the smallest piece of time, is a subject of research for great scholars.

In the Hindu traditions, and especially in the Swaminarayan Sampraday, saints make up the backbone of spiritual life. A special celebration of Sant Din was held in the divine presence of Pramukh Swami Maharaj in which devotees understood the sacrifice and contribution of these saints for the benefit of others.

In the evening cultural program, devotees listened attentively to discourses explaining the good qualities and characteristics of saints. Then, in his blessings to the assembly, Swamishri stated that “saints show true spiritual path leading to God and that is the only real wealth in life.”

The highlight of the evening was the honoring of six youths, born and raised in America, who after two years of training in India, will shortly be initiated into the parshad fold, where they will embark upon the second stage of their training as saints. Swamishri praised their desire to forsake the comforts and to serve the society.

The Bhavnagar region mostly has the diamond industry, and as a side effect of this diamond industry many people have taken up addictions. Today too Pramukh Swami Maharaj made many give up their addictions. Four youths had come together to give up their addictions. Swamishri encouraged them forcefully. Finally he said, "All of you decide that even if someone offers a hundred thousand rupees, we will not drink this poison. Even if a friend says so or the mind says so, we will not indulge in addiction any more."

Meanwhile a man came. Under pressure from a friend he had drunk alcohol. Swamishri said, "Friends who put such pressure on you are not friends but enemies. Only the Sant is a true friend, and only he tells you the truth. So do as he says. Many friends will come, and you will meet many sadhus and ascetics who say such things, but we should not just believe them. You will meet people who say this, but we should keep patience and not waver. If you try to help others give it up, you will gain strength."

To one addicted youth, Swamishri said with a little severity, "Don't you understand? How much trouble this causes? It only does harm in many ways, to the body and to the mind. So give up the addiction." Swamishri said a great deal, but the youth did not respond, so Swamishri himself said, "I am telling you all this, but you are not saying anything at all! We do not want the money you will save. Give milk to your children. Buy something for the house. But do give up alcohol. Say from your heart that you will not take it."
The youth said, "I will never take it."

After performing his morning puja in Navsari Swamishri performed the pratishtha rituals of the murtis of the BAPS hari mandirs in Bhinar and Mahudi. At 10.20 am Swamishri departed from Navsari and arrived at Valsad at 11.00 am. After the welcome rituals Swamishri inaugurated the newly built residence for sadhus.
